name: Wild Man cleaves Wild Strike onto nearby enemies (#2005)
contract: Wild Man 560344 (CharacterAdvancement entry 34175) reads 'Your Wild Strike now strikes 2 additional nearby enemies, but deals reduced damage with each enemy struck.' Its JUMP_TARGETS spellmod cannot add targets to the single-target Wild Strike natively, so ranger_wild_man_cleave (AscensionRangerAssault.cpp) adds up to 2 nearby enemies with carve-style falloff.

Fail-before/pass-after by construction: without the cleave hook the secondary dummy takes no damage from any source (auto attacks stay single-target), so the secondary-damage assertion fails; with the hook it passes. The talent-learn and primary-damage assertions pass in both cases and only prove the setup.

steps.label: SETUP: Wild Strike damages the primary
CONTRACT: Wild Man cleaves Wild Strike onto the secondary
